After an initial consultation, I ended up receiving surgery at Bangkok Hospital. I’m very glad I chose this hospital for my surgery. Everything was great. I received excellent medical treatment starting from the surgeon himself Dr. Romyen, to all the nurses and the entire staff at the hospital.

The room itself where I stayed is amazing, very high tech and very functional, quite pleasant to stay in. The staff is there when you need them, and they let you rest when you need to. The meals were very good as well.
